Bright and clean. Fully stocked. Workers work not ignore you chatting it up. Great deals. Have been purchasing wuite a bit to add & spruce up new home. Carpeting purchase was quick, painless & very cushy & beautiful! No hiccups in the ordering or the work. Super quick install & professionsl. Love itBought wheel barrow, bbq, hardware, etc. going back for supplies to build a greenhouse! I cannot wait & I am female, just think how much my husband loves this place!Store# 8552Pathetic Management and Total Lack of LeadershipThis store is a complete joke, and management is the biggest problem. The employees are clearly there just to collect a paycheck, and it's easy to see why--there's zero accountability. Management is completely checked out. The store manager is useless, and the so-called "managers" under them do absolutely nothing because no one is making them do their jobs. It's a free-for-all of laziness and incompetence.Policies? They don't matter here. Open bags of mulch, soil, and rock in the garden center are supposed to be sold at 50% off, yet no one enforces it. Cashiers don't care, supervisors look the other way, and management couldn't care less. It's a complete failure from the top down.This place is a shining example of what happens when leadership doesn't lead. Pathetic.Business owner informationThe Home DepotBusiness ManagerEvery trip to this store is a headache. This last weekend in particular I dropped in to pick up some light posts and they wouldn't even process match to their own online store. After things being in the wrong aisle and waiting around for 20 mins to get help finding the dang things they wanted me to instead place an online pickup order and wait another 30+ minutes to take home what I'd already spent all the time finding.. not sure if this is corporate malfeasance or just poor store management, probably both. Found what I was looking for on Amazon for half the price anyway.This store was not what I would have expected from a home Depot. I called from a job site to check on the availability of products. I asked the person to please check before I drove one hour there and one hour back. I was assured they have the item on the shelf. When I arrived the product was damaged and unusable. I wasted two hours of my day. The staff was completely apathetic. Lowe's will be my choice in Northern Virginia from now on.Went to Home Depot in Warrenton, Va to rent a snake. Had the best experience and Doronne, my associate was great. very helpful, great personality and would highly recommend him.As a professional designer/contractor, I've spent $75K+ at @HomeDepot in the last 6 months on a whole-house renovation. They are refusing to take a return of a large appliance (stove) which is brand new, un-opened and in the box, but was the wrong size. The manager could not care less that I was a pro customer. They have lost a very good customer. Very disappointing. #HomeDepotWhat a delight this Home Depot was 2 weeks ago when we stopped in to buy a new/old-fashioned electric-coil range, since our 15+ year-old range unexpectedly gave up the ghost."Moe", "Larry", & "Curly" at our local Culpeper Lowe's were so less than helpful that it was laughable, while the two lovely employees at this Home Depot answered our questions, found our perfect product, & had a few-days delivery day set up in a flash. Everything worked like clockwork, & we were enjoying our new range in what seemed to be a heartbeat, unlike the nightmare that Lowe's presented to us. (Think telling us that WE had to call the supplier to find out stock & delivery times; think WE having to call the supplier to find out the differences in the models; think - no, don't bother thinking. Lowe's doesn't.)It was truly a pleasure to get our new appliance at the Warrenton Home Depot.Mixed bag. I went in looking for several items: A gas grill, coolers, and electric fireplaces.I had to go to the Service Desk to get someone to come and talk with me about the grills. The grills have a sign on them that states "Free Assembly." Turns out - the "Free Assembly" is they assemble the grill in the store - okay - great - how the hell do I get the grill home? It sure won't fit in my car! Then he tells me they will rent me a truck to transport the grill. Ugh. Like I want to do that. Just offer me the option of delivering the grill to my house and then assembling it there. But Nooooooooooo! Couldn't possibly offer that as an option! I think I will hold off on the grill for now.Then I asked if they had coolers. The same guy told me he had not seen any and therefore they must not have any. I then walked around and found them. They were up to high for me to reach - so I went back to the Service Desk - a guy named Randy promptly met me on the aisle and pulled two coolers down for me.I also ended up buying several CFL bulbs in red and green (for Christmas). I've never seen CFL bulbs offered in colors - but I should not be surprised.Worst experience with Home Depot I've ever had. Purchased a new refrigerator earlier this week (Tuesday) and arranged for delivery today (Saturday). Salesperson said the delivery crew had to install a new water line for the icemaker. I said fine, even though that made no sense since the old line is copper and in fine condition. Nevertheless, we added a "braided" water line to the sales order. Delivery crew arrived this afternoon - I had the old refrigerator pulled out and disconnected. The lead delivery guy took one look and said I needed to have a shut-off valve behind the refrigerator for the water line. First I'd heard of it - salesperson did NOT mention that requirement. He said he could arrange to have a plumber come by - I said no thanks. I told him just to take the old refrigerator away and set the new one in the kitchen, and I'd finish the installation myself. He said that was "against Home Depot policy". Delivery guy couldn't be reasoned with. We argued a bit, and then he just ran out the door and told the guy at the truck to put the new refrigerator back in - which he did. Then they drove away. I immediately called customer service talked to a Warrenton store manager. She agreed to talk to the delivery folks. A few minutes later a different manager called and said the truck was already back at the warehouse in Maryland - which was a total lie since they hadn't been gone for even 30 minutes - and that they couldn't redeliver for another five days. I told 'em hell no. Manager told me to have a nice day and hung up. Couldn't believe the BS or the lousy attitudes of the people I had to deal with. They acted like I owed 'em a living. Checked around to other stores and decided to go elsewhere to buy. Called Home Depot customer service again and finally got a cooperative and pleasant individual to process the cancellation and refund. I guess 2 out of 4 customer-oriented individuals is all I can expect. Won't be visiting Home Depot anymore.Came to help my mom dad get items no one helped stood in the pro desk for 45 min no help. I will never return to this Home Depot everyone seems lost.
